notes.title: Temporary price drop
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
This is probably our first major announcement for all of you who have supported our project since the very beginning.[/p][p]We are truly grateful for your support and for continuing to believe in our project![/p][p]Due to technical delays and a shift in the release schedule, we’ve decided to temporarily lower the price of the game. We understand how important it is for you to receive content on time.[/p][p][b]Why this matters:[/b]
Developing a complex narrative takes time. However, in order for the project to keep growing, attracting new players is critically important - your support is especially vital right now.[/p][p][b]What’s next:[/b]
This price reduction is a temporary measure to help more people discover the game and join our community. It will allow us to gather more feedback, speed up development, and make the project stronger.[/p][p]Unfortunately, since the start of development, we’ve faced a withdrawal of investor support. At the moment, our team is working purely on internal drive and belief in what we’re creating.[/p][p][b]Thank you for staying with us.
We’re building this for you - and with you.[/b][/p][p][b]D38.[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204966/43f68db94a2ff75390f0bb7563809d0e9c6c1066.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: CELEBRATING THE LAUNCH OF OUR COMMUNITY!
notes.notes:
To mark the recent launch of our community, we're offering 85%!
Join us, share your impressions, and stay updated with the latest news.

[u]The discount will be available from 04/29/25 to 05/13/25.[/u]
